description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DraggableListBuilderTrait' used in Drupal for creating draggable entity listings with weight management, including methods for building headers, rows, forms, and handling form submissions.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the entity list, including a weight column if applicable.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a render array for a single entity row, including weight attributes if applicable.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the form for draggable entities if weightKey is set, otherwise calls parent render.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the form for listing entities with drag-and-drop weight ordering.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validation handler for the form (no validation implemented).

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating entity weights if changed and saving entities.
